subject: Introduce Valkey Over RDMA transport (experimental) (#477)
reason: The change only adds a new optional RDMA transport module (src/rdma.c) that is compiled solely when BUILD_RDMA=module is set (default BUILD_RDMA=no does nothing), plus Makefile/CI/README/test-harness additions. No existing server code path is modified. Exercising it would require a build with BUILD_RDMA=module, loading valkey-rdma.so (MODULE LOAD is refused), and an RDMA device (real hardware or root-configured soft-RoCE rdma_rxe), none of which the fuzzer environment provides.
